subject: Request to substitute a fan-powered alternate VAV box in lieu of the specified

messages.text: We would like to substitute a fan-powered alternate VAV box in lieu of the specified single-duct VAV terminal unit, per Section 23 09 00. This is becoming a priority given current lead times. This substitution is cost-neutral. This substitution will not affect the equipment delivery schedule. A response within three business days would be appreciated. This RFI is unrelated to the pending equipment cost-escalation claim submitted separately.
